1. Privacy First Architecture

+
+ +

1. Introduction & Core Philosophy

+

- booktodotask user privacy aur complete data autonomy ko dhyaan me rakh kar banaya gaya hai. Hum kisi bhi third-party cloud server par aapka koi bhi personal data store nahi karte. + booktodotask user privacy aur complete digital autonomy ko dhyaan me rakhkar build kiya gaya hai. Hum believe karte hain ki aapke personal thoughts, wall tasks, aur diary entries sirf aapki hain.

+

+ Ye application Zero Third-Party Database model par chalta hai. Hamara koi central database server nahi hai jahan aapka data collect ya read kiya jaye. +

-

2. Local Storage & Google Drive Integration

+
+ +

2. How Your Data Is Stored

+
+
+

+ Local Offline Storage: Jab tak aap Google account link nahi karte, aapka sara data (todos, notebook pages, sketches) aapke browser ke localStorage me client-side store hota hai. +

+

+ Google Drive Cloud Sync: Jab aap "Link Drive" opt karte hain, tab direct client-to-cloud request ke through data aapke khud ke Google Drive ke isolated hidden folder (appDataFolder) me save hota hai. +

+
+
+ +
+
+ +

3. Google API Permissions (Scopes)

+

- Jab aap app use karte hain: + Hum Google se sirf ek non-sensitive permission request karte hain:

-
    -
  • Guest Mode: Aapka sara data aapke device ke browser (localStorage) me encrypt/isolated rehta hai.
    • -
  • Google Drive Sync: Jab aap "Link Drive" karte hain, toh data aapke khud ke Google account ke private appDataFolder me sync hota hai.
    • -
  • Scope Permissions: App sirf https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata access karta hai. Iska matlab app aapki Drive ki kisi bhi photo ya private file ko read ya touch nahi kar sakta.
    • -
+
+ https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata +
+

+ Is permission ke chalte app aapke Drive ke kisi bhi personal file, photo, ya document ko dekh, padh ya modify nahi kar sakta. App sirf apne banaye huye workspace file (booktodotask_workspace.json) ko hi access kar pata hai. +

-

3. Zero Telemetry & Data Deletion

+
+ +

4. Data Deletion & Contact

+

- Hum koi analytics tracker, behavioral cookies, ya marketing tools use nahi karte. Disconnect button dabane par session khatam ho jata hai aur browser cache clear karne par local data permanently delete ho jata hai. + Aap kisi bhi waqt header me Disconnect button daba kar Google sync rok sakte hain, ya browser data clear karke local session delete kar sakte hain. Kisi bhi query ke liye aap direct developer se sampark kar sakte hain: devanantpatel@gmail.com.
